units.source_text: 浮舟走进向来认为可怕的老尼僧房中，躺在她旁边，想睡也睡不着。

en.t: Ukifune went into the room of the old nun whom she had always thought frightening, lay down beside her, and could not sleep no matter how she tried.

units.source_text: 老尼僧晚上睡着了，眠鼾声响得可怕。

en.t: When night came, the old nun fell asleep, and the sound of her snoring was terrifyingly loud.

units.source_text: 前面睡着两个年纪很大的尼僧，其眠鼾声之响不让于老尼僧。

en.t: In front of them slept two very elderly nuns, whose snoring was every bit as loud as the old nun's.

units.source_text: 浮舟听了非常恐怖，担心今夜将被这些人吃掉。

en.t: Hearing it, Ukifune was filled with dread and feared that these people might eat her before the night was over.

units.source_text: 她虽然早已不惜生命，但因向来胆小，犹如赴水的人怕走独木桥而折回来一样，心中惶惑万状。

en.t: Although she had long since ceased to value her life, she was timid by nature, and like someone on the way to drown herself who turns back in fear from a narrow log bridge, her heart was thrown into utter confusion.

units.source_text: 她是带了女童可莫姬到这里来的。

en.t: She had brought the young girl Kamohime here with her.

units.source_text: 但可莫姬生性轻狂，看见这难得来的男子在那里说恋情，便逃回那边去了。

en.t: But Kamohime was flighty by nature, and when she saw the rarely visiting gentleman there speaking of love, she ran back to the other side.

units.source_text: 浮舟左等也不来，右等也不来，这真是个不可靠的使女。

en.t: Ukifune waited and waited, but she never came; she was truly an unreliable maidservant.

units.source_text: 中将无可奈何，只得起身回京去。

en.t: The Captain, unable to do anything more, had no choice but to get up and return to the capital.

units.source_text: 少将等都讥评浮舟：“真是一个不通情理的畏畏缩缩的人！

en.t: The Lieutenant and the others all mocked Ukifune, saying, "What an unreasonable, timid person she is!
She lets such a beautiful face go to waste!"
